gtcsolo.rock_breaker.introduction.1: An industrial machine that maintains an internal fluid environment for continuous rock production. Supports Rock Breaker and Advanced Rock Breaking recipes.
gtcsolo.rock_breaker.introduction.2: Accepts up to two ULV Input Hatches for the environment. Each 1,000 mB pair of the required fluids enables one parallel operation, up to eight. Environmental fluids are not consumed.
gtcsolo.rock_breaker.introduction.3: Supports industrial overclocking. Its input and output bonus multiplies with the parallel count provided by the environmental fluids. The internal fluids and moving rocks reflect the running recipe.
gtcsolo.rock_breaker.introduction.4: Advanced Rock Breaking produces Netherrack with Lava and Liquid Nether Air, or End Stone with Lava and Liquid Ender Air. As with an ordinary Rock Crusher, place a sample of the desired rock in the input bus.
